summary: Confirmed $50-65 (June 2027 $50/$60 on Campspot), 50A, 70 ft, Apr 15-Nov 1, Good Sam + military 10%. Added facilities, check-in. WATER LEAD: operator sells river sites, stored not waterfront.
flags: WATER RE-AUDIT LEAD: stored 'not waterfront', but operator's RV sites page says 'several sites along the whitewater River... being by the river' and Campspot tags a 'Waterfront Site' amenity. Imagery: the back-in rows run along the tree band north of the office, with the river under canopy, so imagery neither proves nor vetoes. Page speaks of 'Park Map' but its text was empty on fetch. Needs the audit.

GATE: $50 base June 2027, Oct 2026 $55; Good Sam 10% takes $50 to $45. Passes. Campspot base includes no booking fee; it adds its own at checkout. No gateway within 40 km (Cincinnati 92 km). Google 4.6, 282 reviews, (765) 962-7907.

WORKFORCE LEAN, mild: home page 'We welcome full time guests to make our park their home', naming Reid Health, Primex Plastics, Belden and SugarCreek as nearby. Nightly booking on Campspot and reviews of family weekends say it still sells nights. Not long-stay in character by my read. Review [a year ago] about new owners: 'this place has gone completely downhill'; [2 weeks ago] 'Wonderful RV park'; [2 months ago] 'We absolutely loved our stay'.
